IG Drones.event: Renamed to IG Defence to transition into a full-spectrum defence technology company
IG Drones.evidence: According to press reports, Odisha-based IG Drones officially rebranded to IG Defence in December 2025. The company offers specialized UAV systems like 'Jaga' for emergency reconnaissance and disaster response operations, and partnered with IIT Bhubaneswar to build an Advanced Drone Centre of Excellence for disaster management.

National Restoration Network Pty Ltd.evidence: Australian company registry records confirm the existence of National Restoration Network Pty Ltd (ACN 632 764 660), which operates an emergency disaster relief and flood restoration network via its official website.

Oman Petro Environmental Services Compan.evidence: Oman Petro Environmental Services Company LLC (known as OMAN PESCO, now rebranded as OP) is an active registered Omani SME that operates the website opresponse.com. According to news and business registry directories, the company provides oil spill and HAZMAT incident disaster response services in Oman.

Prodry Co., Ltd..evidence: Prodry Co., Ltd. is an active corporate entity based in Sumida, Tokyo, Japan, established in November 2015.
